question: Can a training-subject population dictionary express held-out continuous-ECG residual morphology, and can frozen radar-derived outputs select its coefficients?
protocol: MMECG loso_v2 folds 5/9 development validation; frozen repaired B1; no held-out calibration; test unopened
dictionary: PCA rank 32 fitted only to train-window raw-ECG residuals (ground truth minus frozen B1 prediction), each 1600 samples

arms.oracle_pca32: B1 plus validation residual projected onto the train PCA basis; diagnostic upper bound using validation ECG
arms.radar_ridge_pca32: B1 plus PCA coefficients predicted by fixed ridge(alpha=1) from frozen B1 prediction and event outputs pooled to 100 time bins

feature_rule: 300 radar-derived features: mean-pooled 100-bin B1 waveform plus two event-logit channels; train standardization; train-only feature PCA rank 64; closed-form ridge alpha 1
gate: oracle_pca32 PCC >=0.75 on both folds; radar_ridge beats mean and B1 PCC on both folds; radar_ridge fold-macro PCC gain over B1 >=0.08 and R2 improves on both
failure_rule: If either representability or radar accessibility fails, do not implement a deep population-dictionary generator from this evidence
test_policy: validation only; test files remain unopened
